title: Advanced Text Processing
task: Create enabled.txt with sorted unique enabled service names from deploy.json. Then create affected.txt containing only enabled services with at least one ERROR event, in the same order with no duplicates.
hints: Use jq -r and select(.enabled) to get plain service names.
Use awk to select the ERROR field exactly. Sort and deduplicate each list under LC_ALL=C.
Use comm -12 on the two sorted lists and capture the intersection in affected.txt.

checks.label: Enabled services are filtered and sorted
checks.feedback: Select JSON enabled records and sort the resulting unquoted names.

checks.label: Only enabled services with errors appear
checks.feedback: Intersect enabled names with unique ERROR services. Disabled cache and INFO events do not qualify.

demo.explanation: Select JSON objects first, then turn their names into a sorted list.
With both inputs sorted, comm keeps only names appearing in both files.
